workflowArticle.proposedTitle: Check the cache-cleaner generation before planning Mac maintenance
workflowArticle.primaryIntent: Help a Mac owner arriving from a Sequoia/Yosemite Cache Cleaner listing identify the current vendor destination, check OS/version scope, and distinguish a maintenance task from an unsupported blanket cleanup promise.
workflowArticle.distinctValue: Legacy discovery-name and current-download reconciliation, followed by task-specific cache/maintenance selection. Not another generic alternatives list or a renamed product matrix.
workflowArticle.leadDirection: The old Sequoia link leads to a Golden Gate notice. Confirm the version and desired task before interpreting today's features or prices as historical Sequoia facts.
outline: Show the recorded identity chain and its limits
Separate cache inspection from antivirus, OS tweaks and emergency-media work
Confirm OS-specific feature support instead of treating a broad compatibility range as universal parity
Use an ownership/rebuild-cost/approval checklist before any cleanup
Choose bounded inspection versus broader maintenance scope; disclose Breathing Room affiliation and preview limitations
